title: Tuplet Etude (flute)

expected.notes: Single-staff flute part, 2 pages, 23 bars. A correct conversion must read every tuplet with its ratio: 3:2 on eighths, quarters (bars 2, 7, 21) and halves (bars 9, 11; cut time), 5:4 on 16ths (bar 4) and on eighths (bar 21, half-bar quintuplet), 6:4 and 7:4 (bars 4, 22), 2:3 duplets and 4:3 quadruplets in 6/8 and 12/8 (bars 14-16, 18), 3:2 sixteenth and 32nd triplets (bars 19-20); tuplets containing rests (bars 3, 12) and mixed values (quarter+eighth, bars 3, 11, 22); the four triplets of bar 6 print no "3" and no bracket (implied) and must still be 3:2. Time signatures take effect at bars 1 (C), 9 (2/2 cut symbol), 14 (6/8), 18 (12/8), 20 (4/4 numeric) - the courtesy signatures at the end of the preceding systems are not changes. Tie g''2 -> first note of a quarter-note triplet (bar 7); fermata on the quarter rest of bar 8 and on the final c'''. Pencil "3"s/fingerings in scan.pdf and scan-severe.pdf are not music.

truth_limitations: <tuplet bracket=...> follows LilyPond's default: bracket omitted only when one beam covers exactly the tuplet; implied tuplets have bracket="no" show-number="none".

Pencil marks in the damaged scans (circles, fingering digits, a fake "3" above notes, ticks, words) are not part of the music and are absent from the truth.
